title: Wildlife Detection in Camera Trap Imagery
description: Detect and localize 12 wildlife species in camera trap images. Each image is from one of 200 camera sites; images from the same site are highly correlated. Train has 50k images, test has 30k. Image resolution is variable (mostly 1024x768 to 3000x2000).
data_summary: Camera trap images from 200 sites. Strong site-level correlation. Variable resolution.
